objects.taxonomy_description: Composite flower with a central yellow disc surrounded by a single whorl of white ray petals (florets). The flower head measures 2-5 cm in diameter with 13-34 elongated white petals radiating outward from the bright yellow center. The petals are narrow, slightly pointed, and arranged in a flat, circular pattern. The flower is supported by a slender green stem with small alternate leaves. The center disc has a bumpy, granular texture from individual disc florets.

Flower_or_Top: Composite flower with central yellow disc surrounded by single whorl of white ray petals.
Flower head is modest in size with numerous elongated white petals radiating outward.
Bright yellow center with bumpy, granular texture from individual disc florets.

Root_and_Base: Single stem supporting composite flower head.

objects.taxonomy_description: 长颈鹿属于偶蹄目长颈鹿科，是现存最高的陆生哺乳动物，以其极长的颈部和独特的骨皮角为显著特征。

diagnostic_checkpoints.颈部: 拥有极度延长的颈部，长度显著超过身体其他部分，用于高处取食。
diagnostic_checkpoints.头部: 头顶具有一对或多对被皮肤和毛发覆盖的骨质突起（骨皮角），而非分叉的骨质鹿角或中空牛角。
diagnostic_checkpoints.四肢: 四肢修长且比例均匀，前肢通常略长于后肢，支撑高大的身躯。
diagnostic_checkpoints.体态: 整体轮廓呈现明显的前高后低倾斜姿态，肩部隆起高于臀部。

objects.taxonomy_description: 浣熊是一种具有显著面部标记和环状尾巴的中型食肉目哺乳动物。

diagnostic_checkpoints.面部: 眼睛周围有深色的黑色面具状斑纹，与浅色面部形成鲜明对比
diagnostic_checkpoints.尾部: 尾巴粗大且蓬松，具有明显的黑白相间环状条纹
diagnostic_checkpoints.体态: 身体结构紧凑结实，四肢短粗，呈现典型的陆生食肉动物姿态
diagnostic_checkpoints.毛色: 全身覆盖灰褐色至黑灰色的浓密皮毛，整体色调较为均一
